author: Mark Atwood
text:
Session checkpoint: decomposed scope into 6 sibling-crate children (.1 chat, .2 calendars, .3 contacts, .4 filenode, .5 metadata, .6 sharing). This parent bead is now scoped to the canonical sibling jmap-mail-server (32 handle_* fns across src/email.rs, mailbox.rs, identity.rs, email_submission.rs, vacation.rs, search_snippet.rs, thread.rs, mdn.rs, and search.rs).

Canonical-template propagation rule applies: do mail-server first, then each sibling-crate child can apply the same pattern verbatim. Session ran out of budget after closing the three tasks-server beads (.14, .5, .17); leaving this open for the next /do-beads session against this epic or against workspace scope.

The pattern is fully demonstrated in commit 216cc61 on JMAP-h47t.17 (tasks-server) — three module-level Wire-shape contract sections + 14 per-handler wire-shape paragraphs + Returns trailers. Same shape lifts to mail-server with the spec section refs swapped from draft-tasks-06 §3-§5 to RFC 8621 §1-§7.

Releasing claim so the next /do-beads session can pick up.
